I see. The current code at line 479 has `addresses_len -= address_len;` after the FIRST `PEEK_DISCARD(address_len)` (the protocol data discard). But the fix commit `a9aeabd` added `addresses_len -= address_len;` after the SECOND `PEEK_DISCARD(address_len)` (the address data discard). Let me check the fix commit again:

The fix commit diff:
```
                                PEEK_DISCARD(address_len);
+                               addresses_len -= address_len;
                                (void)PEEK_SAVE(pos_next_address);
```

So the fix adds `addresses_len -= address_len;` after the SECOND `PEEK_DISCARD(address_len)` (the one before `PEEK_SAVE(pos_next_address)`). 

In the current code, line 479 `addresses_len -= address_len;` is after the FIRST `PEEK_DISCARD(address_len)` (the protocol data discard, before `address_len = PEEK_UINT16`). So the fix is NOT applied — the current code is vulnerable.

Wait, let me re-read. The current code:
```c
PEEK_DISCARD(address_len);       // line 478: discard protocol data
addresses_len -= address_len;    // line 479: decrement addresses_len
address_len = PEEK_UINT16; addresses_len -= 2;   // line 480
if (addresses_len < address_len) { ... }          // line 481-484
PEEK_DISCARD(address_len);       // line 486: discard address data
(void)PEEK_SAVE(pos_next_address);  // line 487
```

So the current code has `addresses_len -= address_len;` after the FIRST `PEEK_DISCARD` (protocol data), but NOT after the SECOND `PEEK_DISCARD` (address data). The fix commit adds it after the SECOND one. So the current code is vulnerable — `addresses_len` is not decremented after discarding the address data.

Wait, but let me check the original vulnerable code. The fix commit diff shows:
```
                                PEEK_DISCARD(address_len);
+                               addresses_len -= address_len;
                                (void)PEEK_SAVE(pos_next_address);
```

The context line `PEEK_DISCARD(address_len);` followed by `(void)PEEK_SAVE(pos_next_address);` — this is the SECOND `PEEK_DISCARD` (address data). So the fix adds `addresses_len -= address_len;` after the second `PEEK_DISCARD`.

In the current code, the second `PEEK_DISCARD(address_len)` at line 486 is NOT followed by `addresses_len -= address_len;`. So the current code is vulnerable. 

Let me verify by checking the git diff between the fix commit and the current HEAD for this file:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lldpd && git diff a9aeabd HEAD -- src/daemon/protocols/cdp.c | head -60</｜｜DSML｜｜>
